sized.rule: seed_count: the smallest of 8-16 whose chance of passing G3, G4 (6 untied) and the exact sign test at alpha 0.05 is at least 0.9, with the expected direction's share at its one-sided 95% lower bound; minimum_effect: the pilot's mean paired difference less 1.645 standard errors (pilot and experiment), rounded down to two significant figures, so S1 holds with about 95% probability for an effect the size of the pilot's; the design uses the larger of it and the host's minimum effect
